Container.Name: ESPScanCam
Container.Overview: ESPScanCam is a self-hosted document scanning system designed for homelab environments. It combines ESP32-CAM hardware capture, smartphone camera capture via the browser, and traditional file upload into a unified scanning workflow. Documents are processed through a configurable OpenCV pipeline with adjustable profiles for deskewing, cropping, contrast enhancement, and format conversion. A mobile-first responsive web UI provides real-time WebSocket updates on scan progress and processing status. Processed documents can be exported to multiple backends including local storage, Paperless-NGX, WebDAV, Google Drive, or SMB network shares. Ideal for digitizing paper documents in a privacy-respecting, self-hosted setup.
